# Jumalancers (JM Web Studio)

> Web design and development studio based in Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico (Pacific Time, same time zone as California). We build fast, SEO-ready websites, landing pages and custom web apps for small businesses in the United States and Mexico, in English, Spanish, bilingual or other languages, at fixed prices in USD.

Estudio de diseño y desarrollo web en Tijuana: diseño de páginas web, landing pages y sistemas web a medida para negocios en México y EE. UU., en español, inglés o bilingües.

## Key pages

- [Inicio (español)](https://jumalancers.com/): Diseño de páginas web en Tijuana — servicios, portafolio, proceso, planes, cotizador y contacto.
- [Home (English)](https://jumalancers.com/en/): Web design & development for small businesses — services, portfolio, process, pricing, quote tool and contact.

## Services

- Website design and development (custom design, mobile-first, fast, on-page SEO).
- Landing pages for Google Ads / Meta Ads campaigns.
- Custom web apps and systems: dashboards, quoting catalogs, ordering and booking systems, internal tools, automations.
- E-commerce and digital catalogs.
- Local SEO and Google Business Profile setup.
- Domain, hosting, SSL, professional email, maintenance and support.

## Pricing (one-time, fixed, USD)

- Starter: $599 — 1 page (up to 6 sections), domain + hosting + SSL for the first year, 1 business email, 7–10 business days.
- Business: $1,199 — 2–3 pages, improved SEO, 3 business emails, 10–14 business days.
- Premium: $1,999 — 4–6 pages, basic branding, advanced SEO and performance, analytics, 5 business emails, 14–21 business days.
- Systems / Apps: from $2,999 — 7+ page sites or web apps with database, login, dashboards, roles and reports. App hosting $79–149/month.
- Renewal after the first year (domain + hosting + SSL): Starter $99/year, Business $149/year, Premium $199/year; includes 2 content updates per year. Extra updates: $29 USD each (up to 10 images or one text block) or $39 USD/month for 4 updates a month.
- Payment: fixed-price proposal; USD or MXN by bank transfer to an account in Mexico.
- Each plan includes one language (English or Spanish). Extras: bilingual or additional languages, pages with more than 6 sections, blog, booking, payments, integrations, extra email accounts ($19/year each).
